resources.string: Mode, accent, dynamic colour & Glass UI
Turn off dynamic colour to choose an accent.
Translucent cards over a soft colour background
Simplifies Tweaks: only the safer controls are shown and applied; the heavy tweaks are hidden.
Hides the heavy/aggressive tweaks — e.g. scheduler boost, GPU force clock, zram sizing, LMK minfree, I/O affinity, TCP low latency and display colour.
Only the safe subset can be read and written through the zperfd engine.
Does not change the active profile or mode — it only limits the manual tweak list.
Disables no safeguard. Turn it off any time to bring back every tweak.
For heat- or power-sensitive devices: keeps Zairenkai on a conservative set of tweaks.
Applies the same conservative filtering to the tweak list as lite mode.
Respects the factory thermal and power limits — Zairenkai never forces past the vendor’s caps.
Does not touch the kernel thermal guard; the kernel safeguards stay in charge.
Meant for stability on mid-range or heat-prone devices. Turn it off any time.
